QuestInfo.name: True Awakening
QuestInfo.1: Through the break in time at #b#m220050300##k, you can return to the past and fight...yourself? It sounds just crazy enough to work. Go to #b#m220050300##k and meet #b#p2151009##k again. #b#p2151009##k will open a Crack in Time for you.
QuestInfo.2: You've finally recovered all of your lost power. All that remains is to push yourself further than before, in preparation for the day that you face the Black Mage!
QuestInfo.0: Even at Lv. 100, you know that you haven't reached your former level of power. You've hit a wall, and you need some guidance. #p2151009# can probably help.

0.0: How your training going, #h0#?\r\n#L0##b#p2151009#. I was preparing to speak with you.#l\n#k
0.1: Really? Cool! I mean, um, yes, #h0#. What is it?\r\n#L0##bI wish to repeat my previous training.#l\n#k
0.2: Previous training? Guess you've hit another wall, then. I don't think repeating that training is going to help, #h0#...\r\n#L0##bI understand, but I seem to be out of options.#l\n#k
0.3: Hm. Wait...wait! I've got an idea. Ohh, I've got a really good idea! You want to get back to your old power level, right, #h0#? In that case, you should practice against #h0#! Or, more specifically, #h0# from the past.

no.0: I know it sounds crazy, but I'm sure it's just crazy enough to work!

mob.0: You were incredibly powerful in the past, #h0#, so I don't think this will be easy. I do think, however, you will learn more from this experience than from any other so far. If you have to get your face kicked in to learn, it's worth it, right? Meet me at the bottom floor of the #m220000000# clocktower, and I'll open a Crack in Time for you.
